::: {#exr-pairs-with-repetition}
#### Choosing two elements with repeats allowed

Let $S$ be a set with $N$ elements.
Choose two elements of $S$,
where the same element may be chosen twice
and the order does not matter.
The five-topping choices of @exr-toppings are the case $N = 5$,
and the same count arises whenever two items are drawn from $N$ kinds with repeats allowed.

::: {.callout-tip title="Hint"}

Split the choices by whether the two elements differ,
as in @sol-toppings,
and count the first kind with the [binomial coefficient](#def-binomial-coefficient)
and @thm-binomial-two.

:::

Compute the number of different choices as a formula in $N$.

:::
